skills.skill_desc:
When Faramis's skills deal damage to enemy heroes and summoned units, they leave behind <font color="a6aafb">Soul Fragments</font>. Absorbing a <font color="a6aafb">Soul Fragment</font> recovers 100<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> HP and grants 2 <font color="62f8fe"><1030></font> (up to 40 stacks).
Upon death, he consumes the absorbed <font color="a6aafb">Soul Fragments</font> to reduce the respawn timer, each reducing the timer by 3% (up to 90%).
He can gain up to 1 Soul Fragment from the same enemy hero using skills every 4s. Enemies that die around Faramis also have a chance to drop <font color="a6aafb">Soul Fragments</font>.

Faramis enters the Shadow state for 3s, gaining 70% Movement Speed, 25 <font color="26e407"><1999></font>, and 20% Cooldown Reduction of this skill. He also gains the ability to move through terrain. Enemy heroes he touches take 250<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and are marked with a Nether Mark. Upon leaving the Shadow state, Faramis pulls all the marked enemy heroes toward him, dealing 250<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>.
<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Ends the Shadow state early to pull marked enemy heroes toward him.
Soul Fragment absorption range is increased while this skill is active.

Faramis gathers Nether energy in a fan-shaped area ahead, dealing 330<font color="62f8fe"> (+144% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies within. The energy will then split and bounce to nearby enemies, dealing 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+86% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> (splits up to 2 time(s) on enemy hero hits and 1 time(s) on non-enemy hero hits).

Faramis turns his surroundings into the <font color="a6aafb">Nether Realm</font> for 6s. Allied heroes within (including himself) enter the <font color="a6aafb">Specter</font> state, gaining 400 (+ 10<font color="62f8fe"> (+5% Total Magic Power)</font>%) extra HP and 50% extra Movement Speed for 1s. When the <font color="a6aafb">Specter</font> state breaks, heroes within clear all debuffs and enter a brief Resurrection state for 1.3s. The <font color="a6aafb">Specter</font> state immediately ends if the allied hero leaves the <font color="a6aafb">Nether Realm</font>.
